name: Francis Baek
title: Assistant Professor of Civil and Environmental Engineering
department: Civil and Environmental Engineering; HARMONIC Lab
fitReason: Recent Assistant Professor with verified foundation-model-to-robot navigation and human-centered sensing interests. Suitable computational directions include robot reasoning, perception, software integration and HRI evaluation, subject to actual project and visitor capacity.

physicalEvidence.summary: The full March 2026 study executes three GPT-4o reasoning modules on an actual Unitree Go2, combining drawing-label YOLO/EasyOCR, a preloaded occupancy map, classical Nav2/A* navigation and visually selected short movements. In a controlled office mock-up, it succeeds at 95/103 positioning tasks across 45 sessions; complete-session success is 37/45. It tests reaching and facing targets, not carrying, welding or assembly; real construction-site testing remains future work. Offboard API reasoning adds latency. Baek is the Georgia Tech coauthor in a Michigan-led collaboration; neither current Georgia Tech apparatus ownership nor independent direction of this experiment is established. Physical score is capped at 20.
